description: Ped Bike System is a dataset listed in Ramsey County open data portal (data.ramseycountymn.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Ramsey County. The Pedestrian Bike Systems (PBS) data set contains line data that represents non-motorized-wheeled (bike, rollerblade, skateboard, etc.) and pedestrian transit routes. Some of the sidewalk and trail locations were originally digitized from Ramsey County 2003 aerial photography DOQs. Coverage: Ramsey County, Minnesota. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are bike, transit, trail, skateboard, sidewalk. The table has 24 columns. The portal shows 2026-02-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ramseycountymn-gov-portal.
